children: Microsoft Foundry, the company's enterprise AI platform, has seen an uptick in customers relying on a range of AI models, including open-source models, CEO Satya Nadella tells analysts on a Wednesday call. Nadella says five times as many customers were building agentic AI tools using multiple AI models during the quarter, with a tenfold increase in Foundry revenue from open-source models. Many analysts have written in recent weeks that the flexibility of Microsoft's AI stack for enterprises positions it to benefit as businesses diversify which AI models they use. (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
